because: The surfaces of the three verifiable negatives of ADR-0056 D5. A negative holds only when the diff touches none of its surface; any contact makes it unverifiable, and the pull request does not declare it (the line is optional, so a wide surface costs nothing: widen rather than refine). Read by tools/quality/check-pr-negatives.ts at the MERGE BASE of the pull request, never from its head. Every pattern is a regular expression over the repository-relative path, compiled case-insensitively, and every name and content marker is compared case-insensitively.

workflow.because: A path added or type-changed at or under the directory is a workflow added (a rename is an addition: the list is read with --no-renames). A symlink at or under .github, added or modified in the diff or present in either tree, can make GitHub read any target as a workflow or action.

schema.because: Names: the .schema suffix in JSON or YAML (320 tracked .schema.json paths over the 22 unarchived libre-ai repositories on 2026-10-23, fixtures excluded), the bare schema.json|yaml|yml, and any JSON or YAML file under a schema/ or schemas/ directory. Content, deliberately wide and failing closed: a raw byte search, no parse, for the substring `schema` or an escape opener (backslash u, backslash x, any case). Every escaped spelling of $schema needs one of them; a file that merely says schema, or escapes anything, is a contact, and the author does not declare the negative.

dependency.because: What is covered, and nothing more. By name: the manifests, lockfiles and workspace files of npm, Bun, pnpm, Yarn, Deno, Cargo, uv, Poetry, PDM, pip, Go, Bundler, Composer, Nix, Maven and Gradle; the registry and package-manager configurations (.npmrc, .yarnrc*, bunfig.toml, pip.conf, pip.ini, uv.toml, .pnpmfile.cjs, Plug'n'Play loaders, import maps); the version files (.tool-versions, .nvmrc, .node-version, .python-version, mise.toml, rust-toolchain*); every action.yml|yaml; .gitmodules. By path: *requirements*.txt|in, requirements/, constraints*.txt, PEP 723 locks (*.py.lock), pylock*.toml, the Gradle version catalog and wrapper, .cargo/, .yarn/, the tooling pins of this repository (*.pin.json, toolchains/ — dependencies of the tooling in the sense of ADR-0056 D4), node_modules/, vendor/, third_party/, patches/, Dockerfile*, Containerfile*, and the workflow and action directories where `uses:` lives. By content: a .py carrying a PEP 723 block (`# /// script`). By mode, in the gate's logic: any gitlink, any symlink, and a symlink in either tree whose path or path-as-a-directory is on the surface. Any status counts, both sides of a rename included.
